text:
maria: Heads-up — noticing a sharp quality drop on Icarus-7b after converting to gguf + int8_perchannel. Eval E2 (conversational QA) accuracy down 6.2pt vs fp16 baseline. Looking for quick triage ideas.
sam: ugh. did you use per-channel or per-tensor? any special clipping params?
maria: per-channel (default converter). command was: `gguf-quantize --model icarus-7b.fp16 --out icarus-7b.gguf --mode int8_perchannel --calib calibset.json` — no extra clip override.
rene: what's the calibration dataset? distribution mismatch is a common culprit.
maria: calibset.json = 2k prompts sampled from our prod prompt set but I filtered for short Qs (<64 tokens). Maybe that's the issue — our eval contains longer dialogues.
tess: try re-running calib with length-matched samples (include some 512-token sequences). also check activations for outlier layers — early attention heads often blow int8.
maria: ok spinning a run with mixed lengths. quick question: do we have a cheap smoke that checks per-layer activation histograms after quant?
quant-bot: automated note: `quant-audit v0.9` can snapshot per-layer min/max/skew. Recommend `quant-audit --model icarus-7b.gguf --calib calibset_long.json --out audit_icarus.tgz`.
lee: pinging infra — if you need to re-run calibration at scale I can provision ephemeral GPUs (1x A100) for 2 hours.
maria: thanks lee — will kick off. also curious if anyone has seen hallucination spikes (not just accuracy loss) post-int8.
sam: yep saw similar on another 7b earlier. It was due to asymmetric bias folding on the last MLP layer — precision loss changed logits scale and increased tail tokens.
rene: could also be kv-cache numeric drift for long contexts. int8 sometimes amplifies rounding when combined with rotary/pos-emb implementation differences.
tess: suggested mitigations in order: 1) length-matched calibration 2) try symmetric per-channel quant (if converter supports) 3) enable bias correction/folding heuristics 4) soft-fall back last MLP to fp16 as a quick A/B.
maria: can we A/B with a hybrid gguf where only output projection stays fp16? how to express that in the toolchain?
quant-bot: notation: `--keep-fp16 layers:lm_head,ffn_out` or use `--hybrid` flag with a layer-list. Example: `gguf-quantize --hybrid "lm_head,ffn_12"`.
lee: provisioning done — `a100-ephemeral-07` ready.
maria: ran length-matched calib + per-channel symmetric option. preliminary eval: accuracy loss reduced to 1.1pt but hallucination rate unchanged.
sam: since accuracy improved but hallucinations persist, check softmax temperature shifts — compare logits stddev per-token between fp16 and int8.
rene: also run a focused set of adversarial prompts that previously triggered hallucinations; isolate which generation step diverges.
tess: if hybrid on last MLP helps that's a low-cost operational rollback — runtime overhead small compared to full fp16.
maria: rolling out hybrid with `ffn_out` fp16 now. will post results in ~20m.
quant-bot: note: log collection enabled. `quant-audit` and model traces will be saved to /tmp/quant_runs/1748123456/.
maria: results: hybrid reduced hallucination triggers by ~70% on the adversarial set, latency penalty ~4% p50. cost delta acceptable for Dedicated.
sam: great. next steps: (1) add length-aware calibration to onboarding checklist (2) add automated per-layer histogram diff to regression alerts (3) recommend hybrid fallback in rollout policy for new 7b models.
rene: agree. also add a note to the compat docs about KV cache numeric sensitivity when switching quant backends.
tess: I can PR the checklist and a small script that generates adv prompt set from prod logs.
maria: thanks everyone. I'll update the model-onboard ticket with the chosen plan: length-matched calib, symmetric per-channel int8, hybrid ffn_out fallback, audit snapshots. tagging @eng-ml for visibility :thumbsup:
